name: Satellos Bioscience Inc.
summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc. is a biotechnology company founded in 2018 and headquartered in Toronto, Canada, working on regenerative therapies for muscle diseases that involve degeneration. It works mainly in Canada and Australia and uses its MyoReGenX platform, an automated microscopy system that reproduces, outside the body, the environment of muscle stem cells. It is developing a small molecule drug for Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
